title: Framework Re-Anchoring
purpose: Defines transition of a reconciled staged repository from its prior accepted framework anchor to a candidate anchor for the supplying reconciliation-target framework while preserving accepted history.

normative_requirements.text: Framework re-anchoring shall occur only after the selected managed reconciliation set has been applied successfully to the staged repository and before complete staged repository validation.

The staged repository shall identify the supplying reconciliation-target repo-spec revision as its candidate current framework anchor for validation; the prior accepted active baseline shall remain represented in durable accepted lineage history.
Re-anchoring shall preserve the original initialization framework identity and every prior accepted reconciliation identity defined by product.framework-reconciliation-lineage.
The reconciliation-target revision shall be represented as a candidate lineage entry during staging and shall not become an accepted lineage entry merely because re-anchoring data was written.

The candidate anchor and lineage evidence shall retain enough immutable identity to resolve the reconciliation-target repo-spec initialization material/output inventory authority used for the reconciliation.

Re-anchoring shall fail closed when the staged candidate identity conflicts with the resolved reconciliation target, when accepted lineage history cannot be preserved, or when candidate provenance would become ambiguous.
